correctness.rationale: The graph and full 216-element automorphism group are reconstructed from explicit edges. Complete 2597-face enumeration gives the face vector and reduced Euler number 10; exact mod-two boundary ranks show only ten mod-two degree-four classes, forcing the rational rank by universal coefficients and Euler characteristic. Two distinct signed Lefschetz calculations agree on all group elements; exact multiplication, conjugacy and commutator enumeration give 13 classes and derived orders 216,54,27,3,1. The characteristic order-three projector has rational ranks 4 and 6. Exact character inner product 432/216=2 establishes absolute irreducibility of both summands. Vanishing sums on the full group and the 108-element bipartition-preserving subgroup establish rational quotient acyclicity by finite-group transfer. Attached code and table were executed and cross-checked.

value.rationale: The Pappus Levi graph is a canonical highly symmetric configuration. The 4+6 absolutely irreducible decomposition comes from a geometrically natural characteristic group element; it detects two inequivalent order-three actions concealed by the ten-dimensional Betti number. Complete group character data determine topological rational invariants of two distinct symmetry quotients, giving a structural, motivated refinement rather than a numerical parameter adjustment.
